text:
Nina (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Marina Logistics activation. Primary goals: connect their app to Redwood hosted API, validate SAML SSO, stream generation audit logs to their ELK, and run a 30-day pilot with a 5k/day token cap. Need owners and a tight timeline.
Ruben (Solutions Eng): I can own the integration playbook + test harness. Suggested cadence: 4bd discovery, 8bd integration, 30d pilot.
Aisha (Onboard PM): Ill build a milestone tracker and weekly syncs. Need Marina IAM and ELK owners.
Diego (Marina IT): Diego here. Hannah (IAM) and Priya (Ops) will help. We use Okta and send logs to a dedicated ELK index.
Hannah (Marina IAM): Okta, SP-initiated SAML preferred. Ill need metadata and a test SP account.
Samir (Security): Marina processes limited PII. Before prod well need SOC2 self-attestation, a simple dataflow diagram, and confirmation of encryption at rest. Ill email the checklist.
Nina (CSM): Draft success criteria: 1) SAML SSO working with test user, 2) generation audit events visible in Marina ELK, 3) integration acceptance tests >=95% on critical prompts, 4) pilot 95th pctl latency <350ms, 5) no P0 incidents for 7 consecutive days. Flagging renewal risk if start delayed beyond 45 days.
Ruben (Solutions Eng): Also include output-stability checks for top-10 prompts. Quick smoke curl for infra folks: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"ping"}'
Aisha (Onboard PM): Workshop options: Tue 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Ill block 1h and capture action items.
Diego (Marina IT): Tue 10am PT works. Hannah and Priya will join.
ops-bot: Event created: "Marina Activation Workshop" Tue 10:00-11:00 PT. Attendees: Nina, Ruben, Aisha, Diego, Hannah, Priya.
Nina (CSM): Action items: Ruben -> draft playbook (3bd), Samir -> security checklist (48h), Aisha -> milestone tracker + invite (done), Diego -> provide Okta metadata and ELK index after workshop.
Ruben (Solutions Eng): Will post playbook link here by EOD.
Samir (Security): Checklist sent to Diego and Hannah. Please attach dataflow diagram when available.
Diego (Marina IT): Thanks, team. See you Tue. Well aim to have IAM metadata ready.
Nina (CSM): Ill run weekly pilot health calls and collect feedback; if early signals are positive well loop in Renewals mid-pilot. :rocket:
